observed_semantics: A physical GRID10 cohort may produce ten immutable NODE_RESULT observations from one exact S1 snapshot S_k.
EXACT_SNAPSHOT_ONLY per-packet admission requires an observation to match current S1.
Each successful per-packet coordinator commit advances S1 epoch/state identity.
Therefore after the first commit, untouched packets from the same S_k cohort are stale by construction.
Silently rewriting their observation epoch/digest as current is forbidden.
problem.consequence: Physical concurrency evidence and sequential fresh admission must not be spliced into one integrated same-cohort claim.

candidate_contract.name: COHORT_EVIDENCE_SET_SINGLE_CAS/v1
candidate_contract.intent: Preserve all simultaneously produced cohort observations exactly as observations of S_k, bind them into one deterministic fan-in object, and admit that object through one coordinator-authorized CAS transition S_k -> S_k+1 without relabeling any member observation as S_k+1.
preconditions: Coordinator lease is established before the cohort observation snapshot is acquired, or lease creation is otherwise included in the exact starting snapshot identity.
All cohort members are ordinary read-only Xeno processes and cannot write S1.

Every member packet carries exact producer/process identity, source membership identity, generation, state_epoch, state_digest, packet_digest, consumed-input/read receipt and scope provenance required by the current acceptance boundary.

All member packets bind the same starting generation/state_epoch/state_digest unless the protocol version explicitly names a heterogeneous-observation mode; v1 forbids heterogeneous starting snapshots.
The coordinator lease, generation and starting S1 digest are current and valid when the batch CAS begins.

fanin_object.cohort_id_rule: RFC8785/JCS hash over protocol version + generation + observed_state_epoch + observed_state_digest + deterministic ordered member identity tuples; transport arrival order is excluded.
fanin_object.member_order_rule: Canonical deterministic order by (source_node_id, producer_process_identity, packet_digest) after uniqueness validation; arrival order must not change the fan-in identity.
fanin_object.immutability_rule: Original member packet generation/epoch/digest/payload/read receipt are immutable. The fan-in object references them; it never rewrites them to the post-commit S1 identity.
fanin_object.hyperposition_rule: Competing or unresolved member candidates remain individually addressable inside the evidence set. Fan-in does not resolve disagreement merely by majority, ordering or recurrence.

validation: validate exact member set uniqueness and membership authorization
validate every member packet/read receipt against S_k and producer identity
validate no member is self-granting capability or effect authority
validate deterministic fan-in digest from exact immutable members
validate conflict policy identifier is admitted and deterministic
single_cas_transition.write_semantics: One deterministic coordinator-authorized S1 transaction stores/adopts the cohort evidence set and its member references, then advances the covered S1 epoch exactly once. All members retain observed_state_epoch=S_k.epoch as provenance.
single_cas_transition.result_identity: The new S1 state S_k+1 may contain the admitted COHORT_EVIDENCE_SET reference. It does not imply that any member observation was made at S_k+1.
single_cas_transition.effect_boundary: No real effect is authorized. Any later ActionCandidate still requires EffectGate/EffectJournal.

downstream_summary_rule.semantics: A coordinator/Xeno may later produce a new candidate summary derived from the immutable cohort set. That summary must reference cohort_id/fanin_digest and original member packet digests, and must carry its own new observation/derivation identity.
downstream_summary_rule.forbidden: The summary may not rewrite original member observations as current facts or mint canonical truth from consensus. UNKNOWN and unresolved Hyperposition branches remain explicit.

architecture_fit: It preserves the current exact-snapshot anti-rebase invariant instead of weakening it.
It creates one deterministic control-plane fan-in boundary rather than ten serial stale-producing mutations.
It generalizes from GRID10 to variable-N HCU without making logical cell count a truth or authority source.
It keeps model outputs as candidates and deterministic S1/Effect boundaries authoritative.
It naturally preserves Hyperposition by retaining the exact member set before any derived synthesis.
why_this_candidate.counterhypothesis: Integrated same-cohort fan-in is not required for the intended physical GRID10 acceptance; split component semantics may be sufficient and substantially simpler.
why_this_candidate.decision_boundary: This artifact does not choose the owner/supervisor acceptance contract. If SPLIT_COMPONENT_SEMANTICS is explicitly selected, this candidate remains donor research only.

falsifiers_and_regressions.setup: Concurrency witness uses cohort C1 but fan-in members come from later process cohort C2 with reused logical node IDs.
Present the same exact member set in multiple transport arrival permutations.
Mutate one payload/read receipt/packet digest after cohort capture.
Repeat one packet/process identity while keeping member_count=10.
Advance S1 after cohort capture but before the batch CAS.
Inject deterministic failure after validation of a strict subset of members.
One member lacks current deterministic membership/health authorization.
Members contain mutually incompatible unresolved candidates plus UNKNOWN.
Replay exact same cohort fan-in request after successful admission.
Provide valid concurrent-liveness evidence plus unrelated sequential fresh commits but no same-cohort fan-in identity.

candidate_eval_concepts: observation time/state identity is distinct from later admission/current state
a deterministic fan-in reference may preserve old observations without relabeling them
majority or recurrence does not mint truth
UNKNOWN and competing Hyperposition branches survive aggregation
stale cohort observations require re-read/recompute or provenance-preserving derivation, never silent currentness rewrite

next_exact_action: If integrated same-cohort fan-in remains the intended contract, implement COHORT_EVIDENCE_SET_SINGLE_CAS/v1 as a bounded deterministic test fixture with CF-001..CF-010 before creating any new GRID10 promotion/runtime pin. If the owner/supervisor instead selects split component semantics, explicitly rename/narrow physical GRID10 acceptance and credit surfaces and retain this artifact as a donor only.
